Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly analyzed the text visible on the GOV.UK page. The Planner stated, "The GOV.UK page shows the Birth section: 'Born 17 January 1863, Llanystumdwy, Caernarfonshire.'" However, the text provided in the conversation clearly shows the birthplace as "Chorlton-on-Medlock, Manchester" (with death place listed as Llanystumdwy). The Planner misread the "Died" line as the "Born" line, leading to the wrong final answer.
